gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clinical and radiographic evidence suggesting a diagnosis of a diffuse high grade glioma (HGG), or a prior diagnosis of a diffuse glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: This early phase I trial studies brain tumor (glioma) metabolism in response to eflornithine (DFMO) and polyamine transport inhibitor AMXT-1501 dicaprate (AMXT 1501) in patients with diffused or high grade glioma.
Patients receive eflornithine PO in combination with AMXT 1501 PO on days 1-5 post-surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Clinical and radiographic evidence suggesting a diagnosis of a diffuse high grade glioma (HGG), or a prior diagnosis of a diffuse glioma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: I. Determine the impact of polyamine depletion on polyamine abundance and the global extracellular metabolome within live human gliomas, in situ.
I. Determine how polyamine depletion impacts extracellular guanidinoacetate abundance.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive eflornithine PO in combination with AMXT 1501 PO on days 1-5 post-surgery.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Population is diffuse/high-grade glioma; glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded at S5). All three arms receive DFMO + AMXT 1501 (only timing differs; Arm II is a registered PLACEBO_COMPARATOR with placebo days 1-2, Arm III a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR with DFMO alone days 1-2), so both drugs coded experimental_combination across arms. Placebo is not a registered intervention and is not listed. Setting coded both because new suspected HGG or prior diffuse glioma diagnoses are allowed. AMXT 1501 moiety taken as written in title (salt dicaprate dropped).
